title: The 5 Largest Deserts on Earth, Ranked (The Sahara Isn't #1)

scenes.text: The five biggest deserts on Earth, ranked. The Sahara doesn't even make the top two.

scenes.label: Gobi · 0.5M sq mi
scenes.text: Number five: the Gobi, in Asia. About half a million square miles of rock, sand and cold.

scenes.label: Arabian · ~1M sq mi
scenes.text: Number four: the Arabian Desert. Roughly a million square miles, much of it empty sand.

scenes.label: Sahara · 3.5M sq mi
scenes.text: Number three: the Sahara. Three and a half million square miles, nearly the size of the United States.

scenes.label: Arctic · 5.4M sq mi
scenes.text: Number two: the Arctic. Five point four million square miles, and nearly all of it ice and snow.

scenes.label: Antarctica · 5.5M sq mi
scenes.text: Number one: Antarctica. Five and a half million square miles. The biggest desert on Earth is frozen.

description:
The five largest deserts on Earth, ranked by area.
A desert is defined by how little rain falls, not by heat, so the top two are polar.
Which desert would you want to cross?
first_comment: Which would you put at number one? Tell us what to rank next.
